minimum_hours.description: Minimum charged, in hours, in the datacenter asked for (default otherwise).

sku.description: Accounting SKU: vps.plan.<code>.<mode>. Prices and minimums are accounting's.

Capabilities.description: What the server's hypervisor can do. Anything off is refused with feature_unavailable.

features.description: What the datacenter offers, in display order (the order form's list); empty when none was set.

first_month_traffic.description: A server created mid-period gets the plan's whole quota (full) or the share of the days left (prorated) for that first period.

rules.description: The terms of buying there, in display order (shown before an order).

error.description: English, for people. Branch on code.

datacenters.description: Datacenter codes it can be installed in.
Datacenter codes it can be ordered in.

included_traffic_gb.description: Traffic quota per period (a calendar month of the region's calendar), GB = 2^30 bytes. No proration. Null: unmetered.

traffic_direction.description: What counts against the quota; null: the datacenter's (download by default).

Price.description: For display; what is charged is accounting's.

core_status.description: The state in core's service vocabulary.

id.description: Unique across regions: datacenter prefix x 10^9 + sequence.

network_suspension_reason.description: The network is cut while the server runs.

paid_until.description: The end of a term paid in the previous panel (#589); the first monthly charge is then.

terminates_at.description: A suspended server is deleted then unless unsuspended.

traffic.description: The current traffic period as last metered; null when unmetered or not read yet.

traffic_overage_billing.description: The traffic overage switch (#595): true bills every GB past the quota; false never does and cuts the network at the quota until the next period.

billable_overage_bytes.description: overage_bytes less the forgiven overage: what is or will be billed.

billed_gb.description: Overage billed so far this period (3 decimals).

capped.description: The network is cut for the traffic cap.

forgiven_gb.description: Overage this period that is never billed (3 decimals): an adopted server's overage billed by the system it came from, or what was over the quota while the overage switch was off.

metered.description: What counts against the quota; null: unmetered plan.

overage_billed_gb.description: Overage sent for billing so far this period (3 decimals). Same as billed_gb.

overage_billing.description: Overage past the quota is billed now (the region bills it and the switch is on).

overage_bytes.description: Counted above the quota this period.

overage_switch.description: The customer's traffic overage switch (#595); PUT /servers/{id}/traffic-settings.

rx_bytes.description: Received by the server (download) in the window.

time_zone.description: The region's zone: day buckets are its calendar days.

tx_bytes.description: Sent by the server in the window.

session.description: A session from POST /auth/exchange with core's handoff assertion.

info.description: Virtual private servers in one region. Every region serves the same API at its own base URL; ids are unique across regions. Long operations answer 202 with an action to poll. Errors carry a stable `code`. Requests are rate limited per caller (RateLimit-* headers, 429 rate_limit_exceeded). An account held until its identity is verified may only read: every other operation answers 403 identity_hold.
